/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c 'import gzip,re; p=\"gencode.vM31.annotation.clean.gtf.gz\"; genes=set(); covered=set(); records=0
with gzip.open(p,\"rt\") as f:
 for line in f:
  if line.startswith(\"#\"): continue
  x=line.rstrip(\"\\n\").split(\"\\t\")
  if len(x)"'!=9 or not re.search(r"(?:''^|; )gene_name '"\\\"Lepr\\\";\",x[8]): continue
  gid=re.search(r\"(?:"'^|; )gene_id '"\\\"(["'^'"\\\"]+)\\\";\",x[8]).group(1); genes.add((gid,x[0]))
  if x[2]==\"exon\": records+=1; covered.update(range(int(x[3]),int(x[4])+1))
print(\"genes\",sorted(genes)); print(\"exon_records\",records); print(\"covered_bases\",len(covered)); print(\"minmax\",min(covered),max(covered))'
awk '{s+="'$4} END{print "merged_sum",s}'"' lepr_merged_exons.tsv
shasum -a 256 gencode.vM31.annotation.clean.gtf.gz"
